content.json:
# AADB — Server Usage & Guardrails
Authoritative server-side model traffic from the production Azure Container App. Data comes from retained structured events in Log Analytics and custom OpenTelemetry model spans in the dedicated Application Insights resource.

> **Privacy boundary:** no prompts, request bodies, model responses, credentials, access tokens, raw IP addresses, user agents, referers, or query strings are retained. Client burst signals use daily rotating HMAC keys.

content.query:
let E = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'azure-diagram-builder-vnet'
| extend event = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(event.event) in ('openai_request_completed', 'openai_request_failed');
E
| summarize Calls=count(), Successes=countif(tobool(event.success)), Failures=countif(tobool(event.success)==false), Status429=countif(toint(event.status)==429), InputTokens=sum(tolong(event.promptTokens)), OutputTokens=sum(tolong(event.completionTokens)), CachedTokens=sum(tolong(event.cachedTokens)), TotalTokens=sum(tolong(event.totalTokens)), RotatingClients=dcount(tostring(event.clientKey)), PeakConcurrency=max(toint(event.peakConcurrent)), LastEvent=max(TimeGenerated)
content.title: Authoritative model traffic

content.query:
let E = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'azure-diagram-builder-vnet'
| extend event = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(event.event) in ('openai_request_completed', 'openai_request_failed');
E
| summarize Calls=count(), Failures=countif(tobool(event.success)==false), TotalTokens=sum(tolong(event.totalTokens)) by bin(TimeGenerated, {Granularity})
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Calls, failures, and tokens over time

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'azure-diagram-builder-vnet'
| extend event = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(event.event) in ('openai_request_completed', 'openai_request_failed')
| extend Model=tostring(event.model), Operation=tostring(event.operation), Status=toint(event.status), Success=tobool(event.success), InputTokens=tolong(event.promptTokens), OutputTokens=tolong(event.completionTokens), CachedTokens=tolong(event.cachedTokens), TotalTokens=tolong(event.totalTokens), DurationMs=todouble(event.durationMs)
| summarize Calls=count(), Failures=countif(not(Success)), Status429=countif(Status==429), InputTokens=sum(InputTokens), OutputTokens=sum(OutputTokens), CachedTokens=sum(CachedTokens), TotalTokens=sum(TotalTokens), AvgDurationMs=round(avg(DurationMs),0), P95DurationMs=round(percentile(DurationMs,95),0), Clients=dcount(tostring(event.clientKey)) by Model, Operation
| order by Calls desc
content.title: Usage by model and operation

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'azure-diagram-builder-vnet'
| extend event = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(event.event) in ('openai_request_completed', 'openai_request_failed')
| summarize InputTokens=sum(tolong(event.promptTokens)), OutputTokens=sum(tolong(event.completionTokens)), CachedTokens=sum(tolong(event.cachedTokens)) by Model=tostring(event.model)
| order by OutputTokens desc
content.title: Token mix by model

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'azure-diagram-builder-vnet'
| extend event = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(event.event) in ('openai_request_completed', 'openai_request_failed')
| where tobool(event.success) == false
| summarize Failures=count(), RotatingClients=dcount(tostring(event.clientKey)), LastFailure=max(TimeGenerated) by ErrorType=tostring(event.errorType), Status=toint(event.status), Model=tostring(event.model), Operation=tostring(event.operation)
| order by Failures desc
content.title: Failure classification

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'azure-diagram-builder-vnet'
| extend event = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(event.event) in ('openai_request_completed', 'openai_request_failed')
| summarize Failures=count(), Status429=countif(toint(event.status)==429) by bin(TimeGenerated, {Granularity})
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Failure and 429 trend

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'azure-diagram-builder-vnet'
| extend event = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(event.event) in ('openai_request_completed', 'openai_request_failed')
| summarize PeakConcurrent=max(toint(event.peakConcurrent)), P95ConcurrentAtStart=round(percentile(toint(event.concurrentAtStart),95),1), Calls=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {Granularity}), RevisionName_s
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Server concurrency by revision

content.query:
let ClientMinutes = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'azure-diagram-builder-vnet'
| extend event=parse_json(Log_s), ClientKey=tostring(parse_json(Log_s).clientKey)
| where tostring(event.event) in ('openai_request_completed', 'openai_request_failed') and ClientKey != 'unavailable'
| summarize Calls=count(), Tokens=sum(tolong(event.totalTokens)) by ClientKey, Minute=bin(TimeGenerated,1m);
ClientMinutes
| summarize PeakCallsPerClientMinute=max(Calls), ClientMinutesOver5=countif(Calls>5), ClientMinutesOver10=countif(Calls>10), ClientMinutesOver20=countif(Calls>20), PeakTokensPerClientMinute=max(Tokens), DistinctRotatingClients=dcount(ClientKey)
content.title: Privacy-safe burst thresholds

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'azure-diagram-builder-vnet'
| extend event=parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(event.event) in ('openai_request_completed', 'openai_request_failed')
| summarize Calls=count(), Failures=countif(tobool(event.success)==false), Tokens=sum(tolong(event.totalTokens)), LastEvent=max(TimeGenerated) by RevisionName_s, Version=tostring(event.version)
| order by LastEvent desc
content.title: Authoritative events by revision

content.query:
ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'azure-diagram-builder-vnet'
| summarize Events=count(), LastEvent=max(TimeGenerated) by RevisionName_s, Reason_s, Level
| top 50 by Events desc
content.title: Container Apps system events

content.query:
let E = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'azure-diagram-builder-vnet'
| extend event=parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(event.event) in ('openai_request_completed','openai_request_failed');
E
| summarize Events=count(), MissingCorrelation=countif(isempty(tostring(event.correlationId))), MissingModel=countif(isempty(tostring(event.model))), MissingOperation=countif(isempty(tostring(event.operation))), MissingClientKey=countif(isempty(tostring(event.clientKey)) or tostring(event.clientKey)=='unavailable'), MissingTokens=countif(isnull(tolong(event.totalTokens))), StructuredProbeEvents=countif(tostring(event.path) in ('/api/health','/api/ready')), LastEvent=max(TimeGenerated)
content.title: Authoritative event completeness

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'azure-diagram-builder-vnet'
| summarize UserAgentMarkers=countif(Log_s has 'Mozilla/' or Log_s has 'curl/' or Log_s has 'python-requests/'), QueryStringMarkers=countif(Log_s has '?'), RawIpv4Like=countif(Log_s matches regex @'(^| )([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}( |$)'), SanitizedAccessRecords=countif(Log_s has 'method=' and Log_s has 'path=')
content.title: Retained-log privacy checks (all marker counts should remain zero)

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where tolower(_ResourceId) endswith '/aadb-usage-analytics-insights'
| where Name == 'aadb.openai.proxy'
| summarize Spans=count(), Failures=countif(Success==false), LastSpan=max(TimeGenerated), AvgDurationMs=round(avg(DurationMs),0), P95DurationMs=round(percentile(DurationMs,95),0) by AppRoleInstance
| order by LastSpan desc
content.title: Dedicated Application Insights custom spans

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == 'azure-diagram-builder-vnet'
| extend event=parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(event.event) in ('openai_request_completed','openai_request_failed')
| project TimeGenerated, CorrelationId=tostring(event.correlationId), Model=tostring(event.model), Operation=tostring(event.operation), Status=toint(event.status), Success=tobool(event.success), ErrorType=tostring(event.errorType), TotalTokens=tolong(event.totalTokens), DurationMs=todouble(event.durationMs), Concurrent=toint(event.concurrentAtStart), RevisionName_s
| top 100 by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Latest authoritative model requests

## Cost allocation
Token totals above are authoritative for AADB server traffic. For billed cost and allocation by call, anonymous browser, session, and workflow, run `python3 scripts/llm-cost-report.py --days 30`. Azure Cost Management is the billing source of truth; telemetry is the usage-allocation source when Foundry deployments are shared.
